name: Deezer API
tagline: Full music catalog search, albums, artists, and playlists with a generous free public API.
description: The Deezer API provides access to Deezer's full music catalog, including search, albums, artists, tracks, playlists, charts, and radio. It offers a generous free public API for developers to integrate music discovery and metadata into their applications.

auth.details: Many public endpoints require no authentication. OAuth 2.0 is used for user-specific data and actions (e.g., managing playlists, user library).

use_cases: search tracks by title or artist name
fetch album metadata and track list
get artist discography and related artists
get chart rankings for a country
